source.method: Bilinear native-DEM sampling, 2x2 area mean per output pixel; local ENU curvature; second-order finite gradients; normalised object normals
source.pngOrientation: north at top; east at right; texture.flipY=true
source.encoding: RGB8 linear UNORM: component=2*channel/255-1; no colour transfer
source.heightReference: same 1737400 m sphere and observer-eye ENU origin as terrain.json
source.coverageStrategy: Largest fully covered centred square among requested width x [1,.9,.8,.7,.6]; no native-data gap fill
limitations: Display shading only; geometry and scientific horizon unchanged
Source pixel spacing is not absolute elevation accuracy
Output is a normal-data map, not measured albedo or a surface photograph
No noise, invented craters or procedural detail added
